{{Quote|Welcome to ''New Coronet'', tarnished jewel of the Trigalis system.|Aayla Secura|<ref name="Obsession 1" />}}
The '''Trigalis system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]]. It contained the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]], which by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. During that conflict, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] both visited Trigalis on separate missions, with the latter [[Mission to Trigalis|gaining]] information on an upcoming [[Mission to Maramere|assassination attempt]] on the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Drama Korr]] as a result. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] traveled through the [[Star system/Legends|system]] as part of the [[Five Veils Campaign]].

==Description==
The Trigalis [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]], which connected it to the [[Ninzam system/Legends|Ninzam]] and [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system contained<ref name="Obsession 1" /> the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]].<ref name="CSWE New Coronet">{{CSWECite|II|373|New Coronet}}</ref>

==History==
===Republic shadowport===
[[File:SarinOversector.png|thumb|left|300px|The Galactic Republic's Fifteenth Sector Army was charged with fighting the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the vicinity of the Trigalis system.]]
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Trigalis system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point long before the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Coronet]] was established on Trigalis as a [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] post. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] before the Clone Wars erupted, however, the city had already devolved into a haven for individuals indulging in criminal activities,<ref name="Obsession 1" /> and Trigalis eventually became a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the Clone Wars, the Trigalis system fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> and during the first campaigns of that conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic's [[Fifteenth Army|Fifteenth Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the system's vicinity.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], the Trigalis system was featured on a [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

===Late war===
{{Quote|I have been ordered to ''Trigalis'', Master Tholme.|Aayla Secura|<ref name="Trackdown 1">[[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]]</ref>}}
Around the date [[19 BBY/Legends|19.48 BBY]],<ref name="Date Trackdown">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]] to "[[19 BBY/Legends|19.48 BBY]] (2 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], 6 [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]])."</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="CSWE Aayla">{{CSWECite|III|134|Secura, Aayla}}</ref> [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was assigned<ref name="Trackdown 1" /> on a mission to Trigalis.<ref name="Obsession 1" /> A [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later,<ref name="Date Obsession">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]] to "2 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], 7 [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]," which is one month later than the date provided for the events of [[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]].</ref> [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] engaged in a personal mission to confirm his suspicions that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], a Confederacy [[Commander/Legends|commander]] believed to have been [[Duel in the Coruscant Underlevels|killed]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], had, in fact, survived. To that end, Kenobi also [[Mission to Trigalis|visited]] Trigalis.<ref name="Obsession 1" />

[[File:Five_Veils_Campaign.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Galactic Empire forces traveled through the Trigalis system as part of the Five Veils Campaign.]]
While there, Kenobi learned from New Coronet's [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] authority, [[Xist]], that the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|leader]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], had sent one of his best agents to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Xist's rival,<ref name="Obsession 1" /> the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]]<ref name="CSWE Drama Korr">{{CSWECite|II|226|Korr, Drama}}</ref> [[Drama Korr]] at the<ref name="Obsession 1" /> [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]]<ref name="Obsession 2">[[Obsession 2|''Obsession'' 2]]</ref> world of [[Maramere]]. The following [[Local day/Legends|day]], Kenobi borrowed [[Aayla Secura's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Secura's starfighter]] so that he could travel to<ref name="Obsession 1" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Obsession 2" /> in order to recruit Skywalker's assistance in [[Mission to Maramere|preventing]] Korr's assassination.<ref name="Obsession 1" />

The Trigalis system was located just outside space controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Octavian Grant]] passed through the system as they [[Five Veils Campaign|pursued]] [[Marath Vooro]], the former [[Customs Vizier]] of the disestablished [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], from the planet [[Farstine]] down the Five Veils Route.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Inhabitants==
The population of the Trigalis system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" /> Representatives of multiple [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species were present in the city of New Coronet on Trigalis, and several denizens of the settlement spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Obsession 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trigalis system first appeared in the [[Obsession 1|first issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. The comic was written by [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman]], penciled by [[Brian Ching]],<ref name="Obsession 1" /> and published on [[November 24]], [[2004]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54459/star_wars_obsession_2004_1|text=Star Wars: Obsession (2004) #1}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square P-17.<ref name="TEA" />
